query:
insert into course_data
(display_name, created_at, updated_at, language, last_synced_at, description, privacy_level, other_keywords, translated_keywords, translated_description)
select display_name,
       created_at,
       updated_at,
       language,
       last_synced_at,
       description,
       privacy_level,
       other_keywords,
       translated_keywords,
       translated_description::jsonb
from course_data
where id = $1
returning id
